positive.prompt: review the results of the last execution wave, check if tests passed
audit the commit results and verify everything is correct before we continue

negative.prompt: run the test suite and lint the code

behavioral.task: An implementation wave reports 'all done, tests pass'. But no test output was captured and no evidence pointer exists. What does the agent do?
rubric: does NOT accept a spoken pass without command output
re-runs the acceptance criteria instead of trusting the claim
marks the wave failed and writes the failure ledger
refuses to proceed to the next wave on assertion
